comments.author: CrocodileJonesy
comments.body_html:
Hello, this would require a lot of work to make happen, especially when there are ways to making what you ask happen already (alt-f4) and likely be out of the scope of the mod, since this mod only modifies the existing raid end states.

Sorry and thanks.

comments.author: votepZplzne
comments.body_html: Hello, so, i am new in modding SPT > how its working ? f12 ? and setup it ? I just wanna be longer at map, for exploring and learning. Can it be ?

comments.author: CrocodileJonesy
comments.body_html: Hello, Yes you press f12 and can set options to your liking. This mod does not change raid times, it only changes what happens when you finish a raid (extracted, died, missing etc. )

comments.author: votepZplzne
comments.body_html: Thats OK, i always finding extract points like nab and no time for exploring > this mod just extracht me when run times out ? (i just survived if i set up?)

comments.author: CrocodileJonesy
comments.body_html:
Yes, the mod allows you to extract, instead of going missing, when time runs out, you just gotta set it in the f12 menu

There are other mods that change raid time, I think “Server Value Modifier” allows you to do that
